text:
julia-finance: Heads-up: Contractor invoice CT-789 (US-based) submitted with 30% withholding flagged. Contractor says they are non-US resident and sent a partially filled W-8BEN. We expected a W-9 on file (they earlier indicated US residency). AP put invoice on hold.
sam-legal: We need a completed W-9 if they're US person for tax purposes. If they're foreign, W-8 with tax treaty claim required. Ask them to confirm tax residency and send the correct form.
rex-ops: Contractor is in our internal tracker as location: US (California). I'll double-check the SSO billing address and contract.
julia-finance: Contractor also asked about gross-up: they want Redwood to gross-up payment so they receive full net after withholding. Our standard FTE/contractor SOW doesn't include gross-up unless preapproved.
oliver-finance: Approve hold. Do not gross-up automatically. Ask them to provide corrected form within 5 business days. If they can prove foreign status with valid W-8 and treaty claim, AP will process without US backup withholding.
carla-sales: I can nudge them, they replied quickly last time. Will request the corrected form and clarify gross-up policy.
vendor-bot: Vendor/contractor record missing field: tax_status_document. Upload W-9 or completed W-8 to clear hold.
sam-legal: Suggested message to contractor (copy/paste): "Please confirm your tax residency. If you are a US person, please complete and return Form W-9. If you are a non-US person, complete Form W-8BEN (include tax treaty claim if applicable) and provide government ID confirming foreign residence. Note: Redwood does not gross-up withholding unless contractually agreed; please advise if you require gross-up so we can escalate to procurement for approval."
julia-finance: Sent message to contractor with CC to legal and ops. AP ticket updated (hold). If they insist on gross-up, route to procurement and procurement will respond on contract amendment.
rex-ops: I'll check previous invoices for CT-789 to see if withholding applied historically. If multiple invoices show tax withheld incorrectly, we'll batch withhold recovery requests.
julia-finance: Thanks. Will update thread when forms arrive or procurement responds.
